name: Cropsey
description: Cropsey is a New York urban legend about a boogeyman figure — originally an escaped mental patient from the abandoned Willowbrook State School — who haunted Staten Island and kidnapped children, later converging with the real crimes of convicted child kidnapper Andre Rand.
origin: The Cropsey legend is centered on Staten Island, New York, and is also found in upstate New York summer camp traditions. It is primarily a New York regional legend.
